scoring_justification: The checker independently recomputes A1,A2,A3,tau_c from the explicit formulas and solves the derived ODE for C12(s); no hidden labels or external gold files required.

outputs.description: Table of spin-wave damping/frequency coefficients and critical correlation time computed from analytic formulas for given (alpha, D) grid.
